Mia found a little blue kite. She carried it into the sunny park. The wind lifted the kite high. Mia laughed and ran across the grass. Her friend Sam came to help. They flew the kite until dinner.
<|endoftext|>
Ben had a small brown dog. The dog liked to chase a red ball. One morning the ball rolled under a chair. Ben reached down and found it. The dog wagged its tail. They played together all afternoon.
<|endoftext|>
Lily planted a tiny seed. She watered the soil every morning. Soon a green stem appeared. The stem grew two bright leaves. Lily showed the plant to her mother. They placed it beside the window.
<|endoftext|>
Noah saw dark clouds outside. He put on his yellow raincoat. Soft rain began to fall. Noah jumped over a puddle. A rainbow appeared above the houses. He hurried home to draw it.
